networks.name: saltbox_coffee
networks.description: Saltbox Coffee website assistant. Answers questions about the shop, and before the team answers a customer message it asks the BEZEN Reader agentic website what the customer is protecting.
sample_queries: A customer wrote: "Where did you get my email address? I never signed up for anything from you. Take me off your list." How should we answer?
A customer wrote: "Just cancel it. Third bag in a row that tasted stale. I'm done." How should we answer?
A customer wrote: "Perfect, switch me to the monthly plan please." How should we answer?
How much is the every-two-weeks plan, and can I pause it?

peer_policy.note: Calls only the BEZEN Reader site in allowed_peers, after the visitor agrees.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
